module-checks.command-3: Verify .superpowers/ is ignored and transient content removed.

V-M-GOVERNANCE.failure: Contradictory contract, invalid XML, or unresolved governance reference blocks all work.

module-checks.command-1: Verify task-XXXX hidden identity, exact sandbox line, starter-comment requirements, order, three closed hints, closed solution, and exact metadata labels.

V-M-TASK-TEMPLATE.failure: Any provenance, prose requirement, extra hint, or open details blocks publication.

module-checks.command-1: Run the full documented docs/task-validation-policy.md command.
module-checks.command-2: Verify Army97CandidateRecord terminal decision and exact CardMigrationEvidence fields in Beads.

V-M-TASK-VALIDATION.failure: Duplicate, incomplete, non-accepted, or non-deterministically verified candidate cannot become a card.

module-checks.command-1: Verify every tasks/task-XXXX/README.md path and one thematic membership.
module-checks.command-2: Verify requirements stay in starter comments and student-facing provenance is absent.

V-M-TASK-LIBRARY.failure: Invalid ID, incomplete starter, or orphan card blocks its wave.

module-checks.command-2: Verify 30 sequential simulations, links, duration sums, two-collection composition, recurrence, and realism evidence.

V-M-CATALOG.failure: Collection drift or invalid simulation blocks cutover.

FlowChecks.VF-ARMY97-CANDIDATE-TO-CARD: Accepted Beads decision precedes immutable card creation.
FlowChecks.VF-ARMY97-CARD-TO-CATALOG: Card, collection, graph, verification, and Beads change together.
FlowChecks.VF-ARMY97-SIMULATION: Static simulation facts are derived from published cards and local checks.
